headline: New study proposes cause for Mars's mysterious 1,000-mile cloud
summary: A new study offers a possible explanation for the 1,000-mile cloud on Mars that has puzzled astronomers since its 2018 discovery, suggesting it may involve ice-forming physics never before observed in nature.

claims.statement: A new study/model offers a possible explanation for the mysterious 1,000-mile cloud on Mars.

sources.quote: Now, a new study offers a possible cause for its appearance.
A new model suggests Mars may host ice-forming physics never directly observed before.
